_comment: One display for both CLIs, based on native (owner, 2026-10-23). What `run` prints, end to end, for a canned model output (KNAIF_LLM_BACKEND=mock, KNAIF_LLM_MOCK_RESPONSE), run in a folder holding only the case's `files` (empty) and `fixtures` (copied from sandbox/fixtures/<skill>/; a case whose fixture is missing, or that runs ffmpeg when it is not on PATH, is skipped) with stdin closed: stdout and stderr byte for byte (`stderr_prefix`: only its start, where the cause is each runtime's own validator message), and whether the run succeeded; `files_after`, when given, is the folder's files once the run ended. `"view": "rich"` runs the terminal view (KNAIF_VIEW=rich, NO_COLOR=1); there every `x.xxx s` timing is compared as `<t> s`, and native's live ffmpeg progress line (redrawn in place, then erased) is left out. Native is the reference: apps/cli/tests/cli_output_parity.rs records the cases under KNAIF_RECORD_CONTRACT=1 and checks them otherwise; Python python/core/tests/test_cli_output_parity.py runs knaif.app's `run` on the same cases.
